# Harvard University
> Harvard University is devoted to excellence in teaching, learning, and research, and to developing leaders who make a difference globally.

Harvard is a federated university with undergraduate, graduate, professional, continuing, and online education across its schools and institutes. This guide highlights core university resources, academic program discovery, major schools, admissions, research, and lifelong learning.

## Core University
- [Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/): Main university homepage with institutional overview, news, events, and navigation to schools and programs.
- [A to Z Index](https://www.harvard.edu/a-to-z/): Alphabetical directory of Harvard schools, departments, offices, centers, and affiliated resources.
- [Academics](https://www.harvard.edu/academics/): Central overview of Harvard’s academic offerings, degree pathways, and learning opportunities.
- [Schools](https://www.harvard.edu/schools/): Directory of Harvard’s schools, faculties, and institutes across the university.
- [Professional and Lifelong Learning](https://www.harvard.edu/academics/professional-and-lifelong-learning/): Overview of continuing education, executive education, and flexible learning options.
- [Programs Search](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/): Searchable catalog of Harvard degree and academic programs across schools and levels.

## Academic Programs
- [Undergraduate Degrees](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/?degree_levels=undergraduate): Filtered listing of undergraduate degree programs offered across Harvard.
- [Graduate Degrees](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/?degree_levels=graduate): Filtered listing of graduate degree programs across Harvard schools and faculties.
- [Professional and Lifelong Learning](https://www.harvard.edu/academics/professional-and-lifelong-learning/): Central entry point for certificates, executive programs, and nondegree study.
- [Harvard Online](https://www.harvardonline.harvard.edu/): Online courses and programs from Harvard schools for learners worldwide.
- [Harvard Division of Continuing Education](https://www.dce.harvard.edu/): Continuing education, extension, and summer learning opportunities for varied audiences.
- [Harvard Summer School](https://summer.harvard.edu/): Summer courses and programs for college students, professionals, and adult learners.
- [Harvard Extension School](https://extension.harvard.edu/): Part-time and online courses, certificates, and degree programs for adult learners.

## Admissions and Student Pathways
- [Harvard College Admissions](https://college.harvard.edu/admissions): Undergraduate admissions information, application requirements, and deadlines for Harvard College.
- [Why Harvard](https://college.harvard.edu/admissions/why-harvard): Overview of academic, residential, and community aspects of the undergraduate experience.
- [Financial Aid](https://college.harvard.edu/financial-aid): Undergraduate financial aid policies, affordability information, and application guidance.
- [Graduate School Admissions](https://www.harvard.edu/academics/graduate-degrees/): Starting point for exploring graduate study options across Harvard.
- [Professional and Lifelong Learning](https://www.harvard.edu/academics/professional-and-lifelong-learning/): Pathways for executive education, certificates, and continuing studies.
- [Harvard Online Courses](https://www.harvardonline.harvard.edu/courses): Browse online courses and flexible learning opportunities from Harvard.

## Harvard College and Arts & Sciences
- [Harvard College](https://college.harvard.edu/): Undergraduate college homepage with academics, admissions, student life, and support resources.
- [Academics at Harvard College](https://college.harvard.edu/academics): Undergraduate concentrations, curriculum, advising, and academic opportunities.
- [Faculty of Arts and Sciences](https://www.fas.harvard.edu/): Harvard’s largest academic division covering arts, humanities, social sciences, and sciences.
- [Graduate School of Arts and Sciences](https://gsas.harvard.edu/): Graduate programs, admissions, and student resources for arts and sciences disciplines.
- [Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences](https://seas.harvard.edu/): Engineering and applied sciences education and research at Harvard.
- [Department Directory](https://www.fas.harvard.edu/pages/department-directory): Directory of departments and academic units within the Faculty of Arts and Sciences.

## Professional and Graduate Schools
- [Harvard Business School](https://www.hbs.edu/): Business education, MBA, doctoral, executive education, and research resources.
- [Harvard Law School](https://hls.harvard.edu/): Legal education, clinics, research centers, and admissions information.
- [Harvard Medical School](https://hms.harvard.edu/): Medical education, biomedical research, and academic medicine resources.
- [Harvard Kennedy School](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/): Public policy and public leadership education, research, and executive programs.
- [Harvard Graduate School of Education](https://www.gse.harvard.edu/): Education-focused master’s, doctoral, and professional learning programs.
- [Harvard Graduate School of Design](https://www.gsd.harvard.edu/): Architecture, landscape architecture, urban planning, and design education.
- [Harvard Divinity School](https://hds.harvard.edu/): Nonsectarian study of religion, ministry, and theological scholarship.

## Additional Schools and Institutes
- [Harvard School of Dental Medicine](https://hsdm.harvard.edu/): Dental education, oral health research, and clinical training programs.
- [Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health](https://hsph.harvard.edu/): Public health education, research, and practice across global health topics.
- [Harvard Graduate School of Arts and Sciences](https://gsas.harvard.edu/): Master’s and doctoral education in arts, humanities, sciences, and social sciences.
- [Harvard Radcliffe Institute](https://www.radcliffe.harvard.edu/): Interdisciplinary institute supporting research, fellows, and public engagement.
- [Harvard Division of Continuing Education](https://www.dce.harvard.edu/): Extension, summer, and continuing education programs for diverse learners.
- [Harvard Schools Directory](https://www.harvard.edu/schools/): Consolidated directory of Harvard’s schools, faculties, and institutes.

## Research and Libraries
- [Research at Harvard](https://www.harvard.edu/research/): University-level overview of Harvard’s research enterprise and impact.
- [Harvard Library](https://library.harvard.edu/): Access point for library services, collections, research support, and discovery tools.
- [Harvard Catalyst](https://catalyst.harvard.edu/): Clinical and translational research support, training, and collaboration resources.
- [Office of the Vice Provost for Research](https://vpr.harvard.edu/): Research policy, administration, compliance, and strategic support information.
- [FAS Research](https://research.fas.harvard.edu/): Research support and administration resources for Faculty of Arts and Sciences investigators.
- [Radcliffe Research](https://www.radcliffe.harvard.edu/research-fellowship-program): Fellowship-based interdisciplinary research opportunities at the Radcliffe Institute.

## Online, Executive, and Continuing Education
- [Harvard Online](https://www.harvardonline.harvard.edu/): Central hub for online courses and programs from Harvard schools.
- [Courses at Harvard Online](https://www.harvardonline.harvard.edu/courses): Browse online offerings by subject, format, and school.
- [Harvard Extension School](https://extension.harvard.edu/): Flexible online and on-campus learning for certificates and degrees.
- [Harvard Summer School](https://summer.harvard.edu/): Summer academic offerings for visiting, current, and adult students.
- [Division of Continuing Education](https://www.dce.harvard.edu/): Administrative home for extension, summer, and continuing education programs.
- [Executive Education at Harvard Business School](https://www.exed.hbs.edu/): Executive programs for business leaders and senior professionals.
- [Executive Education at Harvard Kennedy School](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/educational-programs/executive-education): Public leadership and policy executive programs for practitioners.
- [Professional and Lifelong Learning](https://www.harvard.edu/academics/professional-and-lifelong-learning/): University overview of nondegree and career-focused learning options.

## News, Events, and Public Engagement
- [Harvard Gazette](https://news.harvard.edu/gazette/): Official university news covering research, campus developments, and public-interest stories.
- [Events](https://www.harvard.edu/events/): University events calendar for lectures, performances, conferences, and community programs.
- [Harvard Public Affairs and Communications](https://www.harvard.edu/about-harvard/leadership-and-governance/administrative-offices/public-affairs-and-communications/): Communications office supporting university news and public information.
- [Radcliffe Events](https://www.radcliffe.harvard.edu/events): Public programs, lectures, exhibitions, and interdisciplinary events at Radcliffe.
- [Harvard Art Museums](https://harvardartmuseums.org/): Museum collections, exhibitions, programs, and visitor information.
- [Harvard Museums of Science and Culture](https://hmsc.harvard.edu/): Gateway to Harvard’s science museums, exhibitions, and educational programming.

## Campus and Institutional Resources
- [About Harvard](https://www.harvard.edu/about/): Institutional background, leadership, governance, and university facts.
- [Leadership and Governance](https://www.harvard.edu/about-harvard/leadership-and-governance/): Information on Harvard’s leadership structure, administration, and governing bodies.
- [Campus Services](https://www.harvard.edu/campus-services/): Practical resources for transportation, dining, housing, and campus operations.
- [Visit Harvard](https://www.harvard.edu/visit/): Visitor information, maps, tours, and planning resources for campus visits.
- [Harvard Map](https://map.harvard.edu/): Interactive campus map for buildings, schools, transit, and points of interest.
- [Office for Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging](https://www.harvard.edu/about-harvard/leadership-and-governance/administrative-offices/office-for-equity-diversity-inclusion-and-belonging/): University-wide equity and inclusion initiatives, policies, and resources.
